terms.l: The rules that apply when you book an experience through RomeSoMuch.
s: Who we are

RomeSoMuch di Younes Abbou is registered at Piazza di Villa Carpegna 43, 00165 Rome, Italy, VAT number 17786241004, and can be reached at [email]. These terms govern every booking made through this website.
Booking and confirmation

A booking is complete when you receive our written confirmation by email. Experiences with live availability are confirmed automatically at checkout; all others are requests, which we answer within 48 hours and which become bookings only once confirmed.
Prices and payment
Prices are shown per person or per group, as stated on each experience, and include VAT where applicable. Entry tickets, transfers and meals are included only where the experience says so.
Cancellation

All sales are final unless otherwise noted. Where an experience states its own cancellation terms — on its page and in your confirmation — those terms apply to that booking. If we cancel, for weather, illness or the closure of a site, you choose between a new date and a full refund.
Late arrival and no-show
Meeting points and times are in your confirmation. An experience that has already started cannot be joined late, and a no-show is charged in full.
Your responsibilities

Some experiences involve walking, steps, heat or alcohol. Tell us about mobility needs, allergies or medical conditions when you book, so we can adapt or advise against. Children must be accompanied by an adult.
Liability
We provide the experience with reasonable care and are liable for what we control. We are not liable for third-party closures, strikes, traffic or weather, nor for personal belongings.
Complaints and applicable law
Write to [email] and we answer within 48 hours. Italian law applies, and the courts of Rome have jurisdiction, without prejudice to the mandatory rights of consumers.

privacy.l: What personal data we collect when you book, why, and how long we keep it.
s: Data controller
The controller is RomeSoMuch di Younes Abbou, Piazza di Villa Carpegna 43, 00165 Rome, Italy, [email]. For any request about your data, write to that address.
What we collect

Booking data: name, email, phone, date, number of guests and any notes you send us. Enquiry data: if you write through the work-with-us or partnership forms, the name, contact details, links and text you choose to send. Payment data is handled by our payment provider, and we never see or store card numbers. Technical data: the pages you visit on this site, in aggregate. Advertising data, only if you accept it: the fact that your browser visited this site, sent to Meta so that we can show you our experiences again on Facebook and Instagram.
Why we use it

To confirm and run your booking (performance of a contract), to answer your messages (legitimate interest), to meet tax and accounting obligations (legal obligation), and, only with your consent, to send you occasional emails about new experiences and to advertise this site to you on Facebook and Instagram. Consent is asked for on your first visit and can be withdrawn at any time from the Cookie settings link at the foot of any page.
Who else sees it

The people who need it to deliver your experience: the guide, chef or driver assigned to you, our booking system provider, our payment provider, and our accountant. If, and only if, you accept advertising cookies, Meta Platforms Ireland also receives the fact that your browser visited this site, which is what lets us advertise to you again; Meta acts as an independent controller for that data under its own policy, and transfers outside the European Union rely on its standard contractual clauses. We never sell your data, and we share it with nobody else for their own marketing.
How long we keep it
Booking records for 10 years, as tax law requires. Enquiries that do not become bookings for 24 months. Consent-based emails until you unsubscribe.
Your rights

You can ask for access, correction, deletion, restriction or portability of your data, object to processing, and withdraw consent at any time by writing to [email]. You can also complain to the Garante per la protezione dei dati personali.

cookies.l: Which cookies this site sets, what they do, and how to refuse them.
s: What cookies are
Small files stored by your browser. Some are needed for the site to work; others measure how it is used or come from services embedded in the page.
Technical cookies
Always active, no consent needed. They keep your session, your language and the state of the booking form. Deleting them logs you out of an unfinished booking.
Advertising cookies

Set only if you accept them. We use the Meta Pixel, which tells Meta that your browser visited this site so that we can show you our experiences again on Facebook and Instagram, and so that we can see how many people who saw an advert went on to book. Refusing them costs you nothing: every part of this site, the booking calendar included, works exactly the same.
Third-party cookies

The booking calendar is provided by Bokun (Tripadvisor group) and sets its own cookies when it loads, so that availability and checkout work. Payment pages set cookies for fraud prevention. These services have their own policies.
Managing your choices

The banner that appears on your first visit lets you accept or refuse advertising cookies, and nothing of that kind loads before you choose. To change your mind later, use the Cookie settings link at the foot of any page: your choice is stored in your own browser, so clearing your browsing data resets it and the banner returns. Your browser settings will also delete cookies already stored.
